bugs_found: loan_payment uses incorrect amortization formula: numerator (one_plus_r - 1) equals r instead of (1+r)**m, producing wrong payment values
transfer is not atomic: if the credit to account_to fails after the debit, account_from is left short with no rollback
loan_payment with r==0 returns p/m without quantization while the non-zero branch returns higher precision, inconsistent rounding behavior
fx_convert does not check that the resolved rate is positive, allowing zero/negative FX rates to pass
